title: Frontend Engineer
description:
## About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Frontend Engineer to join our team.

## Responsibilities

- Build and maintain responsive web applications
- Collaborate with designers and backend engineers
- Write clean, maintainable code

## Requirements

- 3+ years of experience with React
- Proficiency in TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
- Experience with Next.js

title: Backend Engineer
description:
## About the Role

We need a Backend Engineer to help scale our infrastructure.

## Responsibilities

- Design and maintain RESTful APIs
- Manage PostgreSQL databases
- Optimize query performance

## Requirements

- 3+ years of experience with Node.js or Python
- Experience with Supabase or PostgreSQL
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Vercel)

title: UX Designer
description:
## About the Role

We are hiring a UX Designer to craft intuitive user experiences.

## Responsibilities

- Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups
- Conduct user research and usability testing
- Collaborate with engineers during implementation

## Requirements

- Portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design process
- Proficiency in Figma
- Experience with design systems

title: Marketing Manager
description:
## About the Role

Lead our marketing efforts and grow brand awareness.

## Responsibilities

- Develop and execute marketing campaigns
- Manage social media and content strategy
- Analyze campaign performance metrics

## Requirements

- 4+ years of marketing experience
- Experience with SEO and paid advertising
- Strong written communication skills

title: Data Scientist
description:
## About the Role

Join our data team to turn raw data into actionable insights.

## Responsibilities

- Build and maintain ML models
- Analyze large datasets to identify trends
- Present findings to stakeholders

## Requirements

- Proficiency in Python and scikit-learn
- Experience with SQL and data visualization
- Familiarity with NLP or recommendation systems
